storage.heading: Notes storage

failure.dropped: The connection to the server dropped, so the recording paused. You can resume it.
failure.write: The recording's file could not be written. The transcript goes on.

transcript.empty: Start recording and what is said shows here.
transcript.speaker: Speaker {{label}}

removeConfirm.title: Delete this recording?
removeConfirm.description: Its file moves to the Trash and its transcript is deleted.

transcript.saveFailed: The transcript could not be saved: {{message}}

passFailed.signed-out: Sign in to NexusCode to transcribe again.
passFailed.expired: It can no longer be transcribed again (that is open for a day after recording).
